notes: This is a transcription reading of manuscript p. 66, scan 134. Main lines 1–7 introduce the written map (218) and the corresponding groupoid map (219), named hom de générisation; the source's untilded target Pi is retained. Lines 7–10 state the author's canonical surjective/injective factorisation discussion. The rest of the main paragraph treats the surjective case, records the inserted alpha(0)=0, displays a D-map and (220), and describes an endpoint tuple by rewriting with repetitions. In line 18 the source ends the primed tuple with d'_r, although the source of (220) above ends with d'_{r'}; both written forms are retained. The final underlined clause stops at un hom. The marginal note discusses the listed Pi forms and alpha-star for the source's non/strictement and non/stricts wording, ending est de la poudre aux yeux, simplement !. The two non forms remain uncertain. No claim on this page has been independently proved, refuted, or repaired in this task. The transcription records the author's text without supplying its missing continuation or using expected mathematics to resolve crossed marks. First-reading coverage: full scan and both prepared full-resolution halves viewed once, then all 17 saved crops inspected; no OCR, external research, or TeX compilation was used. Second-reading boxes are localized by explicitly named target baselines/formulas. Because the diagonal note crosses upright main text and sloping baselines adjoin tightly, each kind identifies the target and excludes crossing neighboring ink as contextual; the complete diagonal note and all adjacent main-body loci have their own boxes. The blind audit restores the marginal abbreviation décroiss. from its terminal point and short outline. It retains the formula alpha(0)=0 above the cancelled homomorphisme and the literal separators in (220), and adds local alternatives for se/a/à and déduite/déduit. These are ink decisions; no mathematical statement was checked.
